sentences.text: Should all university students be required to learn academic writing?
sentences.read: Should all university students be required to learn academic writing?

sentences.text: A recent proposal says yes, and I strongly support it, for academic writing is a basic skill that every student needs, regardless of major.
sentences.read: A recent proposal says yes, and I strongly support it, for academic writing is a basic skill that every student needs, regardless of major.

sentences.text: First of all, academic writing is essential for university study itself.
sentences.read: First of all, academic writing is essential for university study itself.

sentences.text: Students must be able to present ideas clearly, organize arguments logically and cite sources properly, whether they are writing a lab report, a course paper or a graduation thesis.
sentences.read: Students must be able to present ideas clearly, organize arguments logically and cite sources properly, whether they are writing a lab report, a course paper or a graduation thesis.

sentences.text: Without systematic training, many students simply copy information from the internet or make claims without evidence.
sentences.read: Without systematic training, many students simply copy information from the internet or make claims without evidence.

sentences.text: Moreover, learning to write academically sharpens critical thinking.
sentences.read: Moreover, learning to write academically sharpens critical thinking.

sentences.text: To produce a convincing paper, students have to evaluate evidence, compare different views and draw sound conclusions, skills that are valuable in any career.
sentences.read: To produce a convincing paper, students have to evaluate evidence, compare different views and draw sound conclusions, skills that are valuable in any career.

sentences.text: To be effective, however, an academic writing course should be designed to meet the needs of different majors.
sentences.read: To be effective, however, an academic writing course should be designed to meet the needs of different majors.

sentences.text: Engineering students, for instance, may focus on technical reports and data presentation, while literature students may practice writing critical essays.
sentences.read: Engineering students, for instance, may focus on technical reports and data presentation, while literature students may practice writing critical essays.

sentences.text: With such flexibility, the requirement will truly benefit every student.
sentences.read: With such flexibility, the requirement will truly benefit every student.

c31.file: cet4_male/c31_2021年6月大学英语四级_第2套_写作_PartI.mp3

sentences.text: Is technology making people lazy?
sentences.read: Is technology making people lazy?

sentences.text: It is often claimed that computers leave people easily distracted, mentally lazy and less efficient at work.
sentences.read: It is often claimed that computers leave people easily distracted, mentally lazy and less efficient at work.

sentences.text: In my view, technology itself does not make people lazy; what matters is how they use it.
sentences.read: In my view, technology itself does not make people lazy; what matters is how they use it.

sentences.text: It is true that technology can encourage laziness.
sentences.read: It is true that technology can encourage laziness.

sentences.text: With search engines at hand, some people no longer bother to remember facts or think problems through.
sentences.read: With search engines at hand, some people no longer bother to remember facts or think problems through.

sentences.text: Others rely on navigation apps for every trip and rarely try to find their own way.
sentences.read: Others rely on navigation apps for every trip and rarely try to find their own way.

sentences.text: Constant messages and pop-up advertisements also interrupt their work, making it hard to concentrate and lowering their efficiency.
sentences.read: Constant messages and pop-up advertisements also interrupt their work, making it hard to concentrate and lowering their efficiency.

sentences.text: On the other hand, technology can make people more productive when it is used wisely.
sentences.read: On the other hand, technology can make people more productive when it is used wisely.

sentences.text: It frees people from repetitive tasks such as calculating figures and copying documents, giving them more time for creative work.
sentences.read: It frees people from repetitive tasks such as calculating figures and copying documents, giving them more time for creative work.

sentences.text: Online courses and digital libraries also allow them to learn new skills and explore new fields whenever and wherever they like.
sentences.read: Online courses and digital libraries also allow them to learn new skills and explore new fields whenever and wherever they like.

sentences.text: The key, therefore, is self-discipline.
sentences.read: The key, therefore, is self-discipline.

sentences.text: If people treat technology as a tool rather than a crutch, it will make them smarter, not lazier.
sentences.read: If people treat technology as a tool rather than a crutch, it will make them smarter, not lazier.
